trajectory_summary: The call opens with a customer pre-loaded with a cost objection and closes with a booked appointment and the customer volunteering enthusiasm and specific follow-up questions. The rep never directly resolves the payback-period math the customer raises three times, instead redirecting to incentives, trees, and garage roof space — which worked well enough to move the customer from skeptical to interested, but leaves an unaddressed thread for the closer.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day and time (Tuesday at 5) is explicitly confirmed by both parties, and the rep follows with call-logistics expectations (email access, no driving), making this a clean booked outcome via phone appointment. No co-owner was identified — customer confirmed he is the sole title holder.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: The customer discusses an estimated system cost (~$20,000) and estimated savings (~$100/month) but the rep never asks for or captures the customer's actual current utility bill or usage — the entire bill_amount verify item was skipped.
